item.title: First Assist: finding undocumented boulders
item.description: Finds boulders with first-ascent potential from public LiDAR, aerial imagery and open climbing data, and serves them on an interactive map.

item.title: Self-hosted agentic research pipeline
item.description: A multi-agent research pipeline that runs open-weight LLMs on a campus GPU workstation and is operated remotely over Tailscale.

item.title: Agentic-Research: a multi-agent research plugin for Claude Code
item.description: An open-source Claude Code plugin that turns a research workspace into a repeatable pipeline of agents, playbooks and skills.

item.title: Antipode: debate someone who disagrees with you
item.description: A 1-on-1, text-only debate platform that anonymously pairs users with opposing views and rewards persuasion over winning.
